title: Single hieratic sign, Paris, Musée du Louvre, E 25279 (AKU HT 61045)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Kyra van der Moezel; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 61045

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 61045; AKU grapheme Q0090 (AKU GR 509). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: Q3 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 388, 388B. Source publication of this facsimile: Posener-Kriéger und Cenival 1968, pl. 5 A. Occurrence: line 12; find place Pyramidenkomplex des Neferirkare Kakai; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 1.7 x 2.5 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Altes Reich, 5. Dynastie, Djedkare". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (AKU), by Kyra van der Moezel. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
